# Copilot Prompt Pack (ZIO)

Reusable prompt templates for ZIO work in this repository.

## How to use

1. Open one of the prompt files in this folder.
2. Copy/paste it into Copilot Chat.
3. Replace placeholders like `{{TASK}}` with your request.
4. Optionally add scope constraints (for example: "only edit `zio-examples`").

## Templates

- `zio-default.md` - Default prompt for most ZIO tasks.
- `zio-http-endpoint.md` - Add or modify ZIO HTTP endpoints/routes.
- `zio-stream-review.md` - Build/review stream pipelines and failure behavior.
- `zio-zlayer-refactor.md` - Refactor DI and layer wiring.
- `zio-test-generation.md` - Add or improve tests for ZIO and ZIO HTTP code.

## Notes

- These templates assume repository instructions from `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
- Keep versions aligned with project constraints already documented in this repo.
